subject: LGBTQ Parentage and Second Parent Adoption
overview: Host Danielle Balocca summarizes recent Medford City Council budget adjustments before interviewing family law attorney Caitlin Eagleson about same-sex parentage and second parent adoption in Massachusetts.

items.title: Medford City Council Budget Update
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca recaps approved Medford City Council budget adjustments, including funding for public schools, library staffing, a zoning consultant, and election operations.

items.title: Interview on LGBTQ Parentage and Second Parent Adoption
items.summary: Family law attorney Caitlin Eagleson discusses the legal requirements, emotional aspects, and broader societal perceptions surrounding second parent adoptions for same-sex couples in Massachusetts.
